[P2] Materialize pending parents before installing fallback references

When the full input snapshot contains updated terminal context P, terminal child C, and an unavailable ancestor of P, this installs a `DurableParentSpan` for P before processing P's deferred completion. `_finish_operation_end` subsequently treats the placeholder as an existing span: its `end()` does nothing, but P enters `_ended_operation_ids` without being exported. Process pending ancestor completions before installing fallback-only references. Extend the nested-fallback regression with the full `operations` snapshot populated; its empty snapshot currently bypasses this path.
